name: next.js
one_liner: The most widely used framework for building fast, modern websites and web apps with React — the foundation most new startup websites are quietly built on.
buyer: A freelance developer or small dev agency building client websites and web apps who needs a fast, SEO-friendly foundation instead of building routing and rendering from scratch.
business_use_cases: A freelance web developer builds every client site on Next.js and charges for the finished site rather than the framework itself.
An agency builds a repeatable 'launch your startup's marketing site in a week' package using a Next.js starter template.
A SaaS founder builds their entire product, marketing site and app together, on Next.js to avoid stitching together separate frontend and backend frameworks.

money_ideas.idea: Selling premium Next.js starter templates and boilerplates to other developers.
A productized 'website in a week' service for small businesses, built on a reusable Next.js template.

steal_this: Build one polished Next.js landing-page template this weekend and sell it as a $99 boilerplate, or use it to launch a 'website in a week' service.
